<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Opposition protest:</strong> The INDIA bloc plans a mock impeachment of the Chief Election Commissioner at Mallikarjun Kharge’s residence on October 30 following repeated venue denials for their demonstrations.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>ECI affidavit controversy:</strong> The Congress party has formally accused the Election Commission of India of submitting a &quot;deceptive&quot; affidavit to the Supreme Court, escalating the ongoing legal and political battle over electoral transparency.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a></span></li>
</ul>
